newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cubist Pharma as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cubist Pharma as buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it initiated coverage of Cubist Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating.
-- estimated a loss of $0.60 per share for 1996, loss $0.76 for 1997, and loss $1.04 for 1998, versus loss $0.91 for 1995.

-- said company's screening technology to develop antibiotics against drug resistant pathogens "has been validated by Bristol-Myers Squibb Co, Merck and Co Inc, nd Pfizer Inc...with deals worth a potential $98.5 million in to Cubist in research, licensing, equity, and milestone payments."
